garrusi: kuře we duçerxi’o hatewe
english: The boy came forward on a bicycle.

speaker: S24
garrusi: kuře řikab dey we duçerxi’o geyî
english: The boy arrived on a bike (while) pedaling. [lit. The boy pedals up (and) arrived with a bike]

speaker: S24
garrusi: hat le lay gulabîyegan wûsîya
english: He came and stood next to the pears.

speaker: S24
garrusi: le duçerxegey dawûzîya we xwar
english: (He) dismounted from his bike downward.

speaker: S24
garrusi: xistey zemîn
english: He laid it on the ground.

speaker: S24
garrusi: řûwey pay gulabîyegan elgîrî
english: He went to the pears to take them.

speaker: S24
garrusi: ew pîyage nedî lewre
english: He did not see the man there.

speaker: S24
garrusi: dûware nîyagey seri cîyagey
english: He put it again in its place.

speaker: S24
garrusi: ey defi we sebedege’o elgirtey
english: This time (He) picked it up with the basket.

speaker: S24
garrusi: duçerxegey elviřt
english: He lifted his bike.

speaker: S24
garrusi: sûwarî bî
english: He mounted it.

speaker: S24
garrusi: gulabîyegan nîya we ban duçerxege
english: He put the basket of the pears on the bike.

speaker: S24
garrusi: pîyage her ewe hala nedîye
english: The man has not seen him yet.

speaker: S24
garrusi: kuře gulabîyegan birdo rûwey
english: The boy took the pears and went.

speaker: S24
garrusi: pîyage he lew bane
english: The man is still up there.

speaker: S24
garrusi: dikenî le î gulabîyegan
english: He is picking from these pears.

speaker: S24
garrusi: kuře we gulabîyagano duçerxi’o řûwey
english: The boy left with the pears on the bicycle.

speaker: S24
garrusi: dute we duçerxi’o dîyay weřo kuře
english: The girl is coming towards the boy.

speaker: S24
garrusi: geyîn we yêkdîrî
english: They reached each other.

speaker: S24
garrusi: řed bîn le lay yêk
english: They passed by each other.

speaker: S24
garrusi: ew kelawegey elgirt
english: He took off his hat.

speaker: S24
garrusi: gulabîyeganî řîşîya
english: The pears were spilled.

speaker: S24
garrusi: duçerxege kutagey zemîn
english: The bicycle beat him to the ground.

speaker: S24
garrusi: kuře elisîya le cîyegey
english: The boy stood up from his seat.

speaker: S24
garrusi: xoy tekan
english: He shook himself.

speaker: S24
garrusi: cûrawegey kîşîya we xwar
english: He pulled down his sock.

speaker: S24
garrusi: pay zexmdar bîye
english: His leg has become wounded.

speaker: S24
garrusi: payêş tekan
english: He also shook his leg.

speaker: S24
garrusi: ew sê nefere tewyşayan ken hatine wer kumekî biken ewane kwa bikey
english: Those three persons (who) are watching them came forward to help him to collect them.

speaker: S24
garrusi: kumekî kirdin dane dane
english: They helped him one by one.

speaker: S24
garrusi: ewse ew sê nefere kûwayî keno
english: As you see, those three people collect it.

speaker: S24
garrusi: ewêş xoy ditekinî
english: He is also shaking himself.

speaker: S24
garrusi: duçerxegey elviřt ki dûware mîvegan neye ban duçerxege bořî
english: He lifted his bike to put the fruits on the bike again (and) go.

speaker: S24
garrusi: ew kuřêş yê dane tinîse nîzam çes le desîye
english: That boy also, (it) is a tennis (racket), (I) don’t know what (it) is, (which) is in his hand.

speaker: S24
garrusi: ewêş ki ewane elviřî ew kuře
english: He also, that boy, lifts them up.

speaker: S24
garrusi: dûware mîveganî nîya we ban duçerxegey
english: He put his fruits on his bike again.

speaker: S24
garrusi: rûwey
english: He went.

speaker: S24
garrusi: ew sê neferêş weri ew la’o keftin eray rûweyn
english: Those three people also headed for that direction.

speaker: S24
garrusi: ew kuře weri ew çitege’o wazî key
english: The boy is playing with that thing.

speaker: S24
garrusi: kelawegey mînîya we cî
english: His hat was left.

speaker: S24
garrusi: kuře elgirtey
english: The boy picked it up.

speaker: S24
garrusi: we şüşte’ewe fîkki kird
english: He whistled to him with whistle.

speaker: S24
garrusi: fîkkey kird wûsîya
english: He whistled to him (and so) he stopped.

speaker: S24
garrusi: bird kelawege wey bey
english: He took the hat (to) give it to him.

speaker: S24
garrusi: dagey wey
english: He gave it to him.

speaker: S24
garrusi: ewêş kelawege nîya we serî
english: He also put the hat on his head.

speaker: S24
garrusi: kuřêş gilew xward
english: The boy also returned.

speaker: S24
garrusi: hatewe
english: He came forward.

speaker: S24
garrusi: yê danêş gulabî wey da
english: He also gave him a pear.

speaker: S24
garrusi: du dane
english: Two pears.

speaker: S24
garrusi: du dane gulabî weyan da
english: He gave them two pears

speaker: S24
garrusi: hatine wer
english: They came forward.

speaker: S24
garrusi: řest rûwey beygey we ewane
english: He ran (and) went (to) give it to them.

speaker: S24
garrusi: ewane ki le lay bîn
english: Those who were beside him.

speaker: S24
garrusi: yê dane we yê da
english: He gave one (pear) to this one.

speaker: S24
garrusi: yê danêş we ewe da
english: He gave also one (pear) to that one

speaker: S24
garrusi: yê danêş say we qedi kuřwasegey
english: He also rubbed one of them to his shirt.

speaker: S24
garrusi: temîzî kird
english: He wiped it.

speaker: S24
garrusi: düway ewêş yê gazî ley da’o xward
english: Afterwards also, (he) took a bite of it and ate.

speaker: S24
garrusi: dûware tinîsegeyo řûwey
english: He again went with his tennis racket.

speaker: S24
garrusi: pîyage taze le darege’o dîyaye xwar le nerdiwanegewe
english: The man is just coming down the ladder from the tree.

speaker: S24
garrusi: dûware hem (gulabî) hawird xalî bikey
english: He again brought (pears to) empty.

speaker: S24
garrusi: tewyşa kird dî yêkiley le sebedeganî nîye
english: (He) looked (and) saw (that) one of his baskets is not (there).

speaker: S24
garrusi: yêko dûwan
english: One and two.

speaker: S24
garrusi: pes ewkile ka!?
english: So where is the other one?

speaker: S24
garrusi: nîyegey!
english: It is not there!

speaker: S24
garrusi: kî birdey bes!?
english: So, who has taken it away!

speaker: S24
garrusi: ew sê nefere hatin, le ew gulabîyege ki xwen, le nüway yê’o red bîn
english: Those three persons came (and), while eating from that pear, passed in front of him.

speaker: S24
garrusi: xoyêş mînîyaye ewane le kûre hawirdigin le ew gulabîye xwen?
english: He is also left wondering where did they get pears from and eat?

speaker: S24
garrusi: he wucî des we kemer mînîyaye tewyşay ewane key
english: (While he) has stayed with his hand on his waist likewise looks (at) them.

speaker: S24
garrusi: ewane řûweyn
english: They went.
